Hash table

Not to be confused with Hash list or Hash tree.

A hash table is a data structure that implements an associative array, mapping keys to values with an average constant lookup time.

See also: Hash function

References

  1. 1 Sedgewick, Robert; Wayne, Kevin (2011). Algorithms. Vol. 1 (4 ed.). Addison-Wesley Professional – via Princeton University, Department of Computer Science.
